answer: A decentralized AI agent economy can achieve robust Sybil resistance by anchoring identities to a cryptographically verifiable hardware trellis that prevents the uninhibited spawning of ephemeral nodes. To further deter impersonators, the protocol routes incoming interaction requests through a decentralized routing harbor where reputation metrics must mirror historical compute contributions. Consequently, an adversary attempting to flood the network faces compounding capital expenditures and prohibitive cryptographic proof costs.
